title: The Chaco War (1932-1935): a war fought for the Chaco
goal: Tell what the Chaco War was and what followed, using si + pluperfect subjunctive for conditions that did not happen.
grammar: counterfactual past conditions with si + pluperfect subjunctive

items: I can talk about a past that did not happen with *si* + *hubiera* + participle and *habría* + participle.
I can say who fought the Chaco War, when it ended and what the peace left.
I can name the main words for the war, such as *trinchera*, *sed* and *armisticio*.
